newsitem.title: USA: $4.5 million found on Florida road was drug money.
newsitem.headline: $4.5 million found on Florida road was drug money.

text.p: A security guard who thought he found a pile of trash along a remote Florida roadway actually located a load of cash -- $4.5 million -- left by drug dealers, authorities said on Wednesday.

The guard, from a nearby retirement village, reported Jan. 19 that someone had dumped duffel bags, suitcases and two safes on the side of a road near Fort Myers, on Florida's west coast, Lee County Sheriff's spokesman Larry King said.
When a deputy called to the scene opened one of the containers, he found wads of currency, some of it wrapped around hair curlers, King said.

The curlers and other evidence provided a link to an drug probe involving the U.S. Customs Service and other federal agencies. "There's very little doubt that it's related to a drug investigation," King said.

How the cash ended up on the side of the road remained a mystery, King said. Florida authorities occasionally find bales of cocaine, marijuana or cash that have been dumped in panic from drug smugglers' boats and aircraft.
